title: eustylis purpurea
intro: Eustylis purpurea, commonly known as Purple Fritillaria, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the lily family (Liliaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Eustylis purpurea include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relieve coughs and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
